name: Star Salvager: Frontier
description: A 3D spacecraft exploration and mining adventure. Pilot between four planets with spherical gravity, harvest resources, evade raiders, dock at your orbital station and build a powerful ship through branching upgrade trees.
controls: W/S pitch · A/D roll · Q/E yaw · R or Shift throttle up · F or Ctrl throttle down · Space EMP (unlock) · Tab ship terminal · V camera.
